Version 1.0.2 simplifies Audio Sync setup and makes its conclusions match practical synchronization accuracy.

- **Full timeline - Recommended** detects the shorter input duration and distributes checkpoints across it automatically.
- Balanced, Quick, and a consolidated Custom mode replace five separate settings in the main UI.
- Checkpoints no longer run beyond the end of the film when duration metadata is available.
- Dense checkpoint agreement within 10 ms can produce High delay reliability.
- The internal correlation-peak metric is no longer shown in normal results.
- Hunchback of Notre Dame (`+/-0.50 ms`) and Fantasia 2000 (`+/-4.92 ms`) are covered as high-reliability regressions.

Audio Sync still corrects fixed offsets only; it does not compensate for gradual drift or different edits.
